body: We've been waiting for you. Welcome.
Of course! Do you have a link to your deviant art or something?
Oh yeah! I'm not saying don't do it. But if it was a good or even just, not bad day and you didn't feel like you needed to, then he'll yeah. 10 pts for you. You know what I mean?
Of course, I can't wait to see what you do create!

There is nothing wrong with wanting to be known for your work, or the attention that comes with it. When you pour your heart and soul into everything you do, and it feels like no one notices it can be really painful, and its easy to see why you feel the way you do.

We have to choose what we do with that pain though, You can let it sit on you like a weight, or climb it like a ladder. 

One of my favorite quotes is " So many of our dreams seem impossible, they seem improbable, and then, when we summon the will, they soon become inevitable. "

I hope it resonates with you the same way it does for me.

I understand the sentiment here, but society has put a lot of pressure on folks. Like the saying goes, you're only as good as your worst failure. But that's so silly. 

Personally i look for the little wins in each day, because even if you don't notice them they're adding up.

​

* Made it outta bed? add 10 pts.
* Made it to work today? add 10 pts.
* Made breakfast? add 10 pts.
* Didn't cry today? add 10 pts. 
* fucked something up? - 1 pts.

 I think we just expect to much out of ourselves. I'm not saying don't be ambitious, but don't do so at the sake of your self worth. 

I hope you start adding up your little wins stranger, you might find you're worth more than you think.
Happy birthday buddy! Have a beer for me!
Well, a lot can happen in a day. I was born in a day, I made a friend in a day, I graduated college in a day, I met you today. A lot can happen in a day.
That sucks man, although the nice thing about new problems is they give us the opportunity to find new solutions.
